Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal 16:9 website hero photograph, highest supported native quality and resolution.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing office photo, a subject and scene reference only. Image 2 is the authoritative original logo reference; preserve its exact navy tg monogram geometry and exact lettering.
Primary request: Create one entirely fresh, substantially sharper and more authentic professional documentary photograph of the same kind of six-person Ukrainian engineering office team. Three ordinary men and three ordinary women, mixed ages 25–55, normal varied facial features, natural relaxed small smiles. Two men in practical navy work jackets; the other four in casual sweaters/shirts and jeans. No suits, no fashion models. Preserve the believable intimate engineering-team character of reference 1 but materially improve image detail and realism.
Scene: Real modest light contemporary engineering office, daylight windows on the left, simple desks, screens and a few tidy plants. Large original navy dimensional wall sign: exact reference 2 tg monogram above lowercase "techno group", with "engineering company" in a smaller tracked line below. The logo must be optically crisp and readable, preserving the reference's proportions, curves, cutouts and typography without redesign.
Composition: Medium-wide horizontal 16:9 group portrait at desks, all six clearly visible, believable anatomy and hands. Arrange all six faces in nearly the same focal plane so every face is equally tack-sharp. Three seated and three standing closely behind, with unobstructed logo above them. A clean desktop with only an engineering drawing and pen is sufficient. No coffee, books, bags, bottles or unnecessary clutter.
Photographic treatment: Professional full-frame camera, 50 mm lens at f/8, ISO 100, controlled exposure, neutral realistic window daylight, restrained natural contrast and accurate skin colors. Focus precisely on all six faces. Strong resolving detail: distinct eyelashes, iris detail, individual hair strands, fine real pores, age lines and naturally varied skin texture; clearly resolved woven workwear, sweater yarn and jacket stitching/embroidery. The entire group and wall logo are crisply resolved, no shallow depth blur on faces. Clean native image detail and realistic photographic microcontrast.
Constraints: Genuine ordinary staff, attractive believable documentary office photo. Do not reproduce the existing photo's softness. No waxy skin, beauty smoothing, airbrushing, diffusion, misty focus, soft faces, JPEG artifacts, artificial HDR, oversharpening halos, plastic textures, malformed hands or extra people. Only exact wall text "techno group" and "engineering company"; no watermark.
